news_risk: No adverse media or regulator action found in the sources checked. The only litigation trace is tax/DSIR writ litigation, which is ordinary commercial-administrative activity, not a risk event. Note: DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable during this run (connection refused), so news coverage could not be swept — absence of negative news is therefore only partially verified.
note: Sanctions: no match. OpenSanctions consolidated dataset (data current as of 2026-11-27) returned 'No matching entities were found' for 'Advik Hi-Tech'; a broader 'Advik' query returned only three unrelated entities (Advik Textiles and Realpro Pvt. Ltd., Advik Laboratories Ltd, Advik Finance and Properties Pvt. Ltd. — all NSE debarred-entity regulator warnings), none of which is this company. OFAC SDN/Non-SDN list search tool is JavaScript-driven and returned no queryable results via plain fetch, so OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS were not screened name-by-name directly — this is a coverage gap, not a confirmed negative. Court cases: four matters identified on Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org search 'Advik Hi-Tech'), all income-tax appeals and one Delhi HC writ against DSIR; company appears as petitioner/appellant in the active matters and as respondent in the older tax appeals. Per project rules these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action found in the sources checked; not public in what was retrieved. RF/CIS supply: no evidence found — Indian Kanoon searches for 'Advik Hi-Tech' combined with Russia, CIS, Belarus and with export/customs/excise returned zero matching results. This is an absence of evidence, not proof of absence; no shipment or B-L records were reviewed (out of scope for this role). Company website (advikgroup.com) returned empty content on fetch, so no self-declared export markets could be captured.
